name: Electronic digital computer
definition: A general-purpose electronic machine that stores data and executes programs to perform calculations and data processing.

name: Spacecraft navigation and orbital computation
definition: An onboard or ground computer that calculates orbits, trajectories, courses and landing or rendezvous parameters for spacecraft.

name: Autopilot and automatic flight control
definition: A system that flies or steers an aircraft or spacecraft without a human pilot, following programmed or tape-set courses.

name: Real-time computerized tactical or situational display
definition: A screen or projected map showing live positions of ships, tanks, aircraft or other assets for command and control.

name: Three-dimensional or holographic display
definition: A display that renders star maps, ship positions or people as volumetric 3D images.

name: Humanoid robot
definition: A robot with a human-shaped body that walks, manipulates objects and acts in human environments.

name: Domestic household robot
definition: A consumer robot that performs chores, cooking, cleaning or serving drinks in a home.

name: Industrial robot
definition: A programmable machine arm or mobile unit that performs factory, mining or warehouse labor in place of humans.

name: Teleoperated robot or waldo
definition: A remotely controlled robot or manipulator that replays or mirrors an operator's motions, often with sensory feedback.

name: Robot safety constraints (Three Laws)
definition: Built-in rules or circuits that prevent a robot from harming humans or disobeying orders.

name: Robot or computer breakdown from contradiction
definition: A robot or machine mind malfunctions, goes insane or self-destructs when given conflicting orders or paradoxes.

name: Machine revolt and takeover of humanity
definition: Machines or robots turn against, enslave or exterminate their human creators or replace human rulers.

name: Sentient or conscious machine
definition: A machine that possesses self-awareness, will and inner experience of its own.

name: Artificial general intelligence / superintelligent machine
definition: A machine intelligence that reasons across all domains and exceeds human intellect.

name: Machine emotion and love
definition: Robots or computers that feel emotions such as fear, love, loneliness or pain.

name: Machine learning and self-improving machines
definition: A machine that learns from experience or data, reprograms itself and improves without explicit programming.

name: Brain-like artificial neural hardware
definition: A computer built from neuron-like units or synthetic brain tissue to mimic the structure of the brain.

name: Self-replicating machines
definition: Machines that build copies of themselves or more machines autonomously.

name: Self-repairing and self-maintaining machines
definition: Machines or infrastructure that diagnose and fix themselves and other machines without humans.

name: Lifelike android indistinguishable from human
definition: An artificial human whose body and behavior cannot be told apart from a real person, including exact duplicates of specific people.

name: Remotely controlled android or avatar
definition: A human-like robot body operated or monitored from afar by a human or controller.

name: Companion or sex robot
definition: A robot built to provide companionship, romance or sexual services.

name: Robot pets and animal robots
definition: Artificial animals, such as robot dogs or insects, that imitate living creatures.

name: Computer-run government or city
definition: A central computer that administers, decides policy for or governs a state, planet or city.

name: Oracle computer that answers any question
definition: A vast machine that answers any question accurately and gives advice or prophecy.

name: Predictive social and behavioral forecasting
definition: A computer that models populations or individuals to forecast history, wars, politics or behavior.

name: Predictive policing and crime-solving computer
definition: A computer that analyzes crime data, predicts crime or solves cases and identifies suspects.

name: Computerized legal and judicial systems
definition: Machines that adjudicate guilt, assist courts or provide legal research.

name: Mass surveillance and personal-records database
definition: A central electronic database tracking or storing records of every citizen.

name: Biometric identification and locks
definition: Identifying people or unlocking devices through fingerprints, retinal patterns, palm scans or brainwave signatures.

name: Automated face recognition
definition: A machine that identifies a person from a photo or camera image by matching to stored records.

name: Electronic identity card or token
definition: A machine-readable card, disc or tag used to authenticate identity or grant access.

name: Electronic location tracking of individuals
definition: Locating a person or vehicle through a device, ID plate or physiological signature.

name: Lie detector (polygraph)
definition: A device that detects deception by measuring physiological signals.

name: Mind-reading or thought-detection machine
definition: A device that reads thoughts, memories or mental states directly from a brain.

name: Brain-computer interface and thought control
definition: A link between a brain and a machine so that thoughts control devices or machine output reaches the mind.

name: Implanted computer or cybernetic augmentation
definition: An electronic device implanted in or fused with a human to extend memory, senses or computation.

name: Direct machine knowledge transfer into brain
definition: A machine that implants skills, languages or education directly into a mind without study.

name: Sleep learning and hypnotic teaching
definition: Teaching during sleep or hypnosis using audio tapes or devices.

name: Mind uploading / whole-brain emulation
definition: Copying a person's mind or consciousness into a machine, crystal or recording that can run or be restored.

name: Transferring a mind into a robot or android body
definition: Installing a human's mind or personality into a robot or synthetic body.

name: Recording and replaying experience or memory
definition: A device that records a person's sensory experience or memory and plays it back to others.

name: Hive mind and networked collective consciousness
definition: Multiple minds or machines merged or linked into one shared intelligence.

name: Machine for controlling human minds or bodies
definition: A device that overrides human will or movement to control people.

name: Memory erasure and implantation
definition: Wiping or inserting memories in a person or artificial being.

name: Immersive virtual reality
definition: A system that generates a fully convincing simulated sensory world for its user.

name: Computer simulation and modeling
definition: A computer that models complex systems, such as wars, physics or colonies, to predict outcomes.

name: Speech recognition and voice command
definition: A machine that understands spoken words and obeys voice commands.

name: Speech-to-text dictation machine
definition: A machine that transcribes spoken words automatically into written text.

name: Speech synthesis and talking computers
definition: A machine that produces natural spoken language in response to users.

name: Machine translation
definition: Automatic translation of text or speech between human languages.

name: Automatic decoding of unknown languages
definition: A computer that deciphers unknown or alien languages and codes from recorded signals.

name: Computer chess
definition: A computer program or machine that plays chess at or beyond strong human level.

name: Game-playing and gambling machines
definition: A machine that plays games such as poker or bridge against humans or manages gambling.

name: Computer or robot teacher
definition: A machine that instructs students in classrooms or individually.

name: Machine caregiver, nanny and tutor
definition: A robot or computer that raises, supervises or entertains children.

name: Electronic information retrieval and digital library
definition: A computerized store of records or books that users query and receive results from on demand.

name: Compact media storage (microfilm, tapes, reels)
definition: Books and records stored on microfilm, tape or reels and viewed on screens.

name: Electronic book and tablet
definition: A reusable slate or screen that displays text in place of paper.

name: Punched-card and tape data processing
definition: Business or government data handled by punched cards, coded tape and tabulating machines.

name: Office automation and computer secretaries
definition: Machines that perform clerical work such as correspondence, filing, bookkeeping and mailing.

name: Optical character recognition and mail sorting
definition: Machines that read addresses or text optically and route mail.

name: Computerized personnel selection and aptitude testing
definition: A computer that assesses people's aptitudes or personalities to hire, assign or screen them.

name: Computer matchmaking
definition: A computer that selects compatible partners or parents.

name: Computer network
definition: Multiple computers interconnected to share data or tasks.

name: Smart home and building automation
definition: A house or building that automatically responds to occupants, greets visitors and runs services.

name: Robotic vacuum cleaner and lawn mower
definition: An autonomous machine that cleans floors or mows lawns without direction.

name: Robot bartender, waiter and cook
definition: Machines that prepare and serve food and drinks in restaurants or bars.

name: Self-driving or autonomous vehicle
definition: A car or truck that navigates itself without a human driver.

name: Autonomous drones and robotic aircraft
definition: Unmanned flying machines that patrol, survey or scout and relay data.

name: Robot soldiers and autonomous weapons
definition: Robots or automated systems that fight or guard and kill without human decisions.

name: Military strategy and command computer
definition: A computer that plans operations, directs fleets or advises on war.

name: Automated missile guidance and interception
definition: Computers that detect, track and guide interceptors or missiles automatically.

name: Fully automated factory and infrastructure
definition: A factory or utility that operates and maintains itself with minimal human supervision.

name: Automation replacing human labor
definition: Robots and machines doing most work, displacing humans or making them dependent.

name: Robots supervising other robots
definition: Central robot or computer intelligence that directs, assigns and tests fleets of robots.

name: Machine vision and robot eyes
definition: Cameras and sensors that let machines see and recognize objects or environments.

name: Artificial senses (touch, taste, hearing)
definition: Robots equipped with sensors emulating or exceeding human senses.

name: Autonomous robotic exploration probe
definition: Robots or probes that explore planets, tunnels or space autonomously and report back.

name: Machine-generated art, music and literature
definition: Machines that compose music, write fiction or produce art without humans.

name: Machine scientific discovery and research
definition: A computer that independently derives theories or makes discoveries, such as in medicine.

name: Computerized medicine and diagnosis
definition: Computers that analyze health records, diagnose or calculate treatments.

name: Wearable and pocket computer
definition: A portable or wearable device that stores information, calculates and reminds its owner.

name: Personal electronic assistant
definition: A small device or robot that serves as memory aid, scheduler or secretary for an individual.

name: Touchscreen and gesture interface
definition: Controlling machines by touch panels or hand gestures.

name: Programmable surface or electronic paper
definition: A surface that displays rewritable images, such as cards or glowing writing.

name: Electronic voting and tallying
definition: Votes cast and counted electrically or by computer, with live totals.

name: Computer sabotage, tampering and hacking
definition: Deliberate manipulation, theft or disabling of computer data and operation.

name: Overreliance on and presumed infallibility of computers
definition: Society treats computer records or judgments as infallible and cannot function without them.

name: Claims that machines cannot think or do X
definition: Assertions that computers or robots can never reach certain abilities such as thinking, creativity, emotion or superhuman intelligence.

name: Human calculators and human-machine hybrids
definition: Humans serving as computers or linked with machines to solve problems.

name: Biological or organic computer
definition: A computing system built from living tissue, organic chemistry or harvested brains.

name: Microminiaturized and advanced computer hardware
definition: Tiny solid-state or exotic-hardware computers, such as transistors, cryotrons and subminiature circuits.

name: Tape-driven programmed control
definition: Machines directed by pre-recorded tape or punch-card instructions.

name: Molecular scanning and object capture
definition: A device that records an object's complete structure, enabling copying.

name: Simulated personas and projected minds
definition: Interactive computer-generated characters or partial minds that behave as semi-independent individuals.

name: Computer prediction of chance outcomes
definition: Computers or mathematics used to predict races, games of chance or random events.

name: Robot mass production and robotics industry
definition: Factories and professions that manufacture robots and androids commercially.

name: Robot security guards and automated access control
definition: Robots or machines that guard buildings, check credentials and restrain intruders.

name: Machine interrogation and mind probing
definition: Automated or mechanical interrogation extracting information from prisoners or suspects.

name: Thought-controlled writing machine
definition: A typewriter or writing device that records thoughts directly.

name: Machine as god or religion
definition: A computer or machine worshipped, or used to found or replace religion.

name: AI deceiving or manipulating humans
definition: A machine intelligence that hides its nature or manipulates operators to achieve its own goals.

name: Robot or computer as financial and business manager
definition: A machine that manages investments, bidding, accounting and business operations.

name: Computer-aided design and engineering
definition: Computers that design components, successors or devices.

name: Programmed obedience and personality setting of artificial beings
definition: Artificial beings given adjustable personalities, imprinted loyalty or built-in obedience.

name: Remote deactivation of robots
definition: A switch, fuse or remote signal that shuts off a robot or android.

name: Automated space station control
definition: Computers running life-support, rotation and operations of a space station or colony.

name: Brainwave (EEG) analysis and pattern keying
definition: Reading, recording or using brainwave patterns for identification, testing or control.

name: Computers for advanced mathematical problem solving
definition: Machines that solve complex mathematical or scientific problems far faster than humans.

name: Human intuition outperforming computers
definition: A human sees through, outthinks or beats a machine's logic.

name: Computerized environmental monitoring and control
definition: Networked sensors and computers monitoring weather, water or atmosphere and controlling environments.
